label: ZMYM2::FGFR1

sections.text: ZMYM2 encodes a zinc-finger transcriptional coregulator.
FGFR1 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.

The fusion retains the FGFR1 kinase and replaces receptor control with a partner-derived self-association region, producing constitutive signaling. FGFR1-rearranged neoplasms can involve myeloid disease and lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia, with progression to blast phase.
Pemigatinib is US-approved for adults with relapsed or refractory myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms harboring an FGFR1 rearrangement. ZMYM2 and BCR were frequent partners in FIGHT-203.
